SPARK_LOCAL_IP not picked up by SparkR
Issue Type: Bug
Assignee: Unassigned
Created: 15/Jan/15 6:29 AM
Environment:

Spark 1.1.1, Hadoop 2.5.0, Mesos 0.21.0
Priority: Minor
Reporter: Martin Tapp

Hi,

For some reason, I'm setting SPARK_LOCAL_IP and I still see my Mesos cluster using my first network adapter (Ubuntu Trusty 64 on both the driver and cluster side). The workaround I'm using for now is to ifdown my first adapter so that Spark picks the second one.

I've tried setting the environment through my shell (export SPARK_LOCAL_IP) and through sparkEnvir as well as sparkExecutorEnv as passed to sparkR.init (i.e. passing SPARK_LOCAL_IP="1.2.3.4" where 1.2.3.4 would be the IP of my network adapter).

What should I do? (I don't want to set SPARK_LOCAL_IP globally either)

Thanks,

Martin
